title: Stasher silicone containers
text: Stasher silicone containers. I am trying to move toward making less trash... using less gas (bought a hybrid car) and in general doing things better for our environment.  Every little bit counts, right?  These bags are great to replace single use bags.  They wash in the dishwasher wonderfully but take a good deal of time to fully dry.  You need to set them in a dish rack overnight for thorough drying.  Then there is storage of the bags.  I am still working on that.  Currently I am using a wire basket in my pantry.  It's a start.  They are a investment to purchase, so I will collect them a few at a time after purchasing this first set.  You can cook in them (boiling water or microwave), dishwasher clean, and freeze in them. They are said to be free of dangerous chemicals and food safe use.  They are a foggy clear... you can see what's in them, but not strictly clear... I just got them so I can't really speak to the longevity of these, but having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Stasher Silicone Reusable Storage Bag, Go Bag (Waterfall) | Food Meal Prep Storage Container | Lunch, Travel, Makeup, Gym Bag | Freezer, Oven, Microwave, Dishwasher Safe, Leakproof
features: CLIP IT & GO: As the name implies, this Stasher bag is made to stay within reach on a backpack or belt loop. Keep your phone dry while hiking or yogurt melts on hand with a li’l one in tow.
REUSABLE, REWASHABLE, RELOVABLE: Safe for the dishwasher, microwave, oven (up to 425°F), and more, Stasher reusables make it easy to ditch single-use plastic and meet endless household needs.

BETTER SILICONE BAGS & BOWLS: Made with platinum food-grade silicone and a leak-free Pinch-Loc seal, they’re free from lead, latex, BPA, and BPS. Plus, one bag replaces 260 single-use plastic bags a year.
MINIMAL PACKAGING: To achieve our mission of creating a waste-free world, all orders are shipped in plastic-free, brown paper packaging with inserts — we promise they are new and authentic!.
LITTLE BAG = BIG CHANGE: To date, our Stasher Squad has kept 5.5 billion single-use plastic bags from the ocean a year. And a portion of sales is donated to nonprofits protecting ocean health.
description: Made for every adventure, from town to trail! With its easy-clip recycled aluminum carabiner, the Go bag keeps essentials at your fingertips. Perfectly sized for your phone, hand sani, and other need-to-haves-right-now. Pro tip: please remove the carabiner before placing your Go bag in the dishwasher, microwave, or oven.
